goal: Create a network scanning tool that can scan hosts and ports, gather device information, and output results in JSON format.
acceptance_criteria: The script must accept IP addresses or hostnames as input
The script must support port ranges and individual ports
The script must handle CIDR notation for host specification
The script must provide timeout functionality
The script must output results in JSON format
The script must include comprehensive error handling
The script must have detailed logging capabilities
The script must validate inputs for ports and hosts
The script must support multiple concurrent scans
The script must be testable with pytest
